description: Source code for CCS811 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, data fetching, and control functions.

methods.name: set_wake
methods.description: Controls the wake GPIO pin and waits for specified duration.

methods.name: fetch_status
methods.description: Reads the STATUS register and ERROR_ID if error is set.

methods.name: ccs811_result
methods.description: Returns the latest sensor measurement results.

methods.name: ccs811_configver_fetch
methods.description: Fetches hardware and firmware version info from the sensor.

methods.name: ccs811_baseline_fetch
methods.description: Reads the baseline value from the sensor.

methods.name: ccs811_baseline_update
methods.description: Updates the baseline value in the sensor.

methods.name: ccs811_envdata_update
methods.description: Updates environmental data (temperature and humidity) in the sensor.

methods.name: switch_to_app_mode
methods.description: Switches the sensor to application mode.

methods.name: ccs811_mutate_meas_mode
methods.description: Changes the measurement mode of the sensor.

methods.name: ccs811_set_thresholds
methods.description: Sets threshold values for sensor alerts.

methods.name: ccs811_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, performs reset, configuration, and mode setup.
